author: Daedalus IV
title: Synergy Paper Gen. Test (1/2): FWPCA + Combat
abstract: To satisfy reviewer feedback, this is the first of two generalization experiments for a paper on hard+soft feature selection synergy. This experiment establishes a new baseline by applying a soft-weighting (FWPCA-like) method to a simple Combat baseline.
